guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul / Jackson Randy Rhoads model / Gibson Les Paul (Wylde "Bullseye")
guitar.evidence: Randy Rhoads played Gibson Les Pauls and the Karl Sandoval-built polka-dot V (later Jackson's signature Randy Rhoads model) on "Crazy Train"/"Mr. Crowley"; Zakk Wylde's bullseye Gibson Les Paul is iconic for "Bark at the Moon"-era and beyond.
guitar.notes: Was unknown despite Ozzy's guitarists being among the most documented in metal history; filled with high confidence.

tone.target: warm 90s hard rock crunch with long sustain
tone.profile: warm 90s hard rock crunch with long sustain
tone.summary: A warm, mid-focused signal chain using a British amp model (UK 45 or UK 50), boosted by an OD pedal for crunch, followed by chorus and delay to achieve the desired '90s stadium rock' sound.

rig.name: Ozzy Osbourne - No More Tears - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and noise inherent in high-gain hard rock playing.
Provide the necessary warm crunch and midrange thickness for rhythm playing (the 'boosted lead' feel).
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen over Blues/OD 9 to maintain a vintage, less aggressive grit suitable for late-90s rock.

blocks.purpose: Add foundational gain and sustain without sounding overly modern or scooped.
blocks.gap: Using the general 'Distortion' model to simulate a classic Marshall-style saturation, avoiding the extreme gains of RAT/Muff.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic British 'stadium' sound (Marshall-style) with strong midrange presence.
Provide the classic British rock cabinet tone required for the genre.
Add the required 'slight chorus shimmer' without making it dominant.
Provide the short delay for lead sustain and depth.
Add subtle depth and 'stadium framing' without sounding overly wet.
Fine-tune the tone to emphasize thick midrange and warm crunch.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for a more authentic 90s hard rock sound.

proposals.recommendedAsset: song-appropriate IR (e.g., Celestion Greenback or British 4x12)
proposals.reason: Enhance the vintage, mid-focused character of the cabinet.
